title: kbext.py init-team writes a group overlay repository: a marketplace pinning it-ops-kb by ext tag beside the group's plugin, its settings file and a verified sample extender
goal: kbext.py init-team DIR --group NAME --upstream URL --ref TAG writes DIR/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing it-ops-kb with a url source at URL and TAG beside the group's own plugin whose source is the marketplace root; it writes DIR/.claude-plugin/plugin.json with skills, agents and hooks directories for the group's own; it writes DIR/settings/group.json naming the group, extension_paths ../ext and a sample ranker in DIR/ext that kbext.py verify passes; a second run changes nothing; a file that holds other content is never overwritten: init-team exits 2 naming it; plugin.md has a section on adopting by fork or by overlay that design.md's Teams and organizations links

clauses.clause: kbext.py init-team DIR --group NAME --upstream URL --ref TAG writes DIR/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing it-ops-kb with a url source at URL and TAG beside the group's own plugin whose source is the marketplace root
it writes DIR/.claude-plugin/plugin.json with skills, agents and hooks directories for the group's own
it writes DIR/settings/group.json naming the group, extension_paths ../ext and a sample ranker in DIR/ext that kbext.py verify passes
a file that holds other content is never overwritten: init-team exits 2 naming it
plugin.md has a section on adopting by fork or by overlay that design.md's Teams and organizations links

gates.question: How does a group's overlay marketplace pin the shared it-ops-kb plugin?
gates.reason: Claude Code has no version ranges or release channels, so an exact tag is the only pin that holds a major back; the group moves the ref after kbext.py verify and rehearse pass
